meta_title: Family Food Tours Malaysia: Kid-Friendly | Simply Enak
meta_description: Family-friendly food tours in KL and Penang. Kid-sized portions, bathroom breaks, slower pace. Children welcome on all tours. From RM 285.
hero_subtitle: Adventures that work for every age
hero_description: Children are welcome on every Simply Enak tour. We adjust the pace, the portions, and the stories so that kids, parents, and grandparents all have a great time.
travel_type_name: {"en":"Food Tours for Families in Kuala Lumpur"}
why_perfect_content:
Travelling with children is hard enough without mealtime battles. Our family tours:

- Include kid-friendly dishes: roti canai, satay, fresh fruit, and mild noodles
- Move at a slower pace with bathroom breaks built in
- Feature interactive elements: watching roti being stretched, tea being pulled, satay being grilled
- Tell stories that engage children: why the wok is so big, how the uncle makes the noodles so long
- Keep groups small so families don't feel lost in a crowd

tips.title: Morning Tours Are Easier
tips.content: Kids have more energy in the morning. Our 9am tours work better for families than evening ones.

tips.title: Bring Snacks and Water
tips.content: Even with food at every stop, familiar snacks help anxious eaters feel secure.

tips.title: Private Tours for Young Children
tips.content: If your child is under 5, we strongly recommend a private tour so we can adjust the route and pace completely.

meta_title: Couples Food Tours Malaysia: Date Night | Simply Enak
meta_description: Romantic food tours for couples in KL and Penang. Small groups, intimate settings, shared discoveries. Perfect date night. From RM 285.
hero_subtitle: The best dates involve shared discoveries
hero_description: Forget dinner-and-a-movie. Our couples food tours are designed for two people who want to experience something new together — and talk about it for years.
travel_type_name: {"en":"Food Tours for Couples in Kuala Lumpur"}
why_perfect_content:
There's something about experiencing new flavours together that creates better memories than any restaurant reservation. Our couples tours:

- Move at a relaxed pace with time to talk between stops
- Include intimate settings: hidden courtyards, rooftop views, family kitchens
- Feature shared plates that naturally encourage feeding each other
- End at a dessert spot perfect for lingering
- Are small enough to feel private, even in a join-in group

tips.title: Book a Private Tour
tips.content: For the most romantic experience, a private tour lets us customise every stop to your pace and preferences.

tips.title: Consider the Night Tour
tips.content: KL's night food tour has a completely different energy — more atmospheric, more intimate.

tips.title: Extend to Penang
tips.content: Couples who do both KL and Penang tours consistently tell us it's the highlight of their trip.

meta_title: Foodie Tours Malaysia: For Serious Eaters | Simply Enak
meta_description: Food lover tours in KL and Penang. 10+ tastings, generational vendors, recipe histories. For serious foodies. From RM 285.
hero_subtitle: For people who plan trips around meals
hero_description: You don't just want to eat — you want to understand. Our foodie-focused tours dive deep into technique, history, and the generational knowledge behind every dish.
travel_type_name: {"en":"Food Tours for Foodies in Kuala Lumpur"}
why_perfect_content:
We don't do 'tasting portions' or tourist-friendly simplifications. On our foodie tours, you'll:

- Meet vendors who have cooked the same dish for 40+ years
- Learn the difference between wok hei and burnt
- Understand why Penang assam laksa uses torch ginger flower and KL laksa doesn't
- Taste dishes that aren't on any menu — arranged specially for our groups
- Get the recipe stories: where they came from, how they evolved, who's keeping them alive

tips.title: Come Hungry
tips.content: This is not a light stroll. You'll eat more than you expect. Skip breakfast.

tips.title: Ask Questions
tips.content: Our guides love technical questions. The more specific, the better.

tips.title: Book the Market Tour
tips.content: For the deepest dive, our Chow Kit market tour reveals the ingredient layer most tourists never see.
